sourceAnchors.visualArbitrationNote: Printed page 311 visually preserves two source-defined five-phase routes toward katatoniforme Sperrung. Inflation route: I Sch=0+, II Hemmungsphase Sch=±+, III Entfremdungsphase Sch=−±, IV Verdrängungsphase Sch=−0, V Sperrungsphase Sch=−!0 or −!!0. Projection route: I Sch=0−!, II Verneinungs-/Dissimulationsphase Sch=−−, III Zwangs-/Fugues-Phase Sch=±−, IV Verdrängungsphase Sch=−0, V Sperrungsphase Sch=−!0 or −!!0. The record retains the two complete sequences in one method object because the source presents them as two variants of the same Schutz-/Abwehrvorgang.

romanianRendering: Szondi folosește profilurile succesive pentru a descrie două trasee în cinci faze către Ichsperrung: unul pornind de la Inflation și unul de la Projektion. Ambele trec prin etape intermediare de Verneinung/Hemmung, Entfremdung sau Zwang, apoi Räumung/Verdrängung, ajungând la Sperrungsphase.
doctrinalStatement: Pagina 311 formulează două secvențe longitudinale distincte ale Ich-Abwehr în cadrul interpretării katatoniforme. Traseul inflativ este: Sch 0+ -> Sch ±+ -> Sch −± -> Sch −0 -> Sch −!0/−!!0. Traseul proiectiv este: Sch 0−! -> Sch −− -> Sch ±− -> Sch −0 -> Sch −!0/−!!0. Secvențele sunt modele source-defined ale unei transformări succesive și trebuie citite ca atare; ele nu justifică deducerea retroactivă a unei faze lipsă și nici aplicarea în afara contextului sindromatic pentru care Szondi le formulează.
conditions: Requires successive Sch profiles in chronological order.
Use exact source-defined reaction configurations and preserve the distinction between the inflation route and the projection route.
exceptions: Do not infer omitted intermediate phases when the observed series does not contain them.
Do not generalize these two sequences to all longitudinal Szondi change patterns.
Do not convert the sequence into a generic severity or improvement scale.
scopeNotes: The two sequences are kept together because Szondi presents them as parallel forms of the same katatoniforme Schutz-/Abwehr progression.
The source's clinical labels for the phases are historical doctrine; this record does not create a runtime diagnosis.

relations.note: Specifies the two explicit five-phase longitudinal sequences that follow the general observation of schubweise Ich-Abwehr changes.
